name: Claude badge
author: Brett
description: Tests the AI connection every time the console loads and attaches a Claude badge to the banner (framework badge asset, top left). Connected: green, and a tooltip pops out to its right for 5 seconds saying “Powered by” and the model (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5). Account works but out of credits: amber, “Out of credits”. Can't connect (bad token or invalid account): grey, “AI unavailable”. The icon for each of the three states is picked in its settings. Uses the AI assistant's model service (axf.llm@1). Removing the plugin removes only the Claude badge; the banner, badge and clock asset types stay in the framework. When connected, the tooltip also names the active Claude account's email (from AI keys, when installed). Follow Amber (Nov 4 2026): tapping the badge switches Follow Amber on or off (the shared followAmber.enabled switch); while it's on the badge draws two-tone (its connection colour plus a faded second tone) with an animation, and pulses when Amber opens something. Everything it did on tap before (settings, test again) is in its right-click / long-press menu, with the last thing Amber opened and Change badge. Looks: 20 badge assets (looks.json, brand-icon looks among them), any brand-package icon as the badge, an animation per state (12 styles, speed, intensity, loop), all in its settings with live previews and over REST, MCP and the CLI.

items.title: Claude badge looks and animations
items.description: Every Claude badge look (id, name, brand or not, its badge data), every animation (sweep, breathe, rotate, shimmer, ripple, glow, wave, orbit, heartbeat, aurora, sparkle, tide, none), the animation states (follow, opened, connecting, error) and the style in use.

items.title: Change the Claude badge look
items.description: Change the Claude badge: input {look? (a look id from styles-list), icon? ('' = the look's own, icon:<name>, mark:<logo-mark id>, anim:<animated-logo id>, glyph:<icon-pack id>/<glyph>), tone2? (the faded second tone while Follow Amber is on: neutral|success|warning|danger|accent|muted), color2? ('' or #rrggbb), animations? {state: {motion, speed, intensity, loop}}}. Every open console repaints the badge.

items.title: Set a Claude badge animation
items.description: One state's animation on the Claude badge: input {state: follow|opened|connecting|error, motion? (from styles-list), speed? (seconds per loop, 0.3-30), intensity? (0-1), loop? (false = play once)}.
